guidance.identity: Copy the actual book, reading-section and anchor identity; do not invent a conventional verse for a special unit.
guidance.token_alignment: Populate greek_tokens with token_id, form, lemma, morphology, clause_id, english_spans, realization_type and rationale. realization_type can be explicit, grammatical, implicit or unresolved. Account for every token with many-to-many alignment when needed.
guidance.alternatives: Record reading, category (textual_variant or translation_alternative), evidence_ids, rationale and disposition. Do not invent consulted sources.
guidance.reviewers: Record reviewer identity, human_or_ai, qualification/role, independence, exact scope, date and decision; an AI pass is not independent human review.
guidance.publication: A prepared draft has no publication status beyond draft. Verify each output before recording release completion.
